# FFmpeg core 0.12.10

Files ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm are unmodified files from the @ffmpeg/core@0.12.10 npm package (dist/umd), retrieved through jsDelivr.

License: GPL-2.0-or-later. See COPYING.GPLv2. FFmpeg source/build instructions and dependency licensing are available from:

- https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
- https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
- https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ffmpeg/core/v/0.12.10

The existing wrapper in ../influencer-video-ffmpeg/vendor/ is reused; this directory adds only the pinned single-thread core and its notice.
